message: New Issue Type Volume sheet — your top 50 issue types with the category each belongs to, and a filter to narrow to one category at a time. Add it via iiQ Data > Add Analytics Sheet > Issue & Requester > Issue Type Volume. Dashboard charts are also more readable: cards now grow with the number of bars instead of being a fixed height, every category label is shown, and each bar carries its value. Charts that mixed a percentage with a ticket count now put them on separate axes so both are visible. Reload the dashboard to pick this up.
